name: EXSTETRA
description:
Exstetra follows Ryoma, a high school student chosen to become a Prisma, the savior destined to protect Amejia, a Tokyo fused with another world and doomed to destruction.

During his journey, Ryoma meets future Prisma Knights who share his mission. By awakening their powers with a kiss, he joins them on an adventure to save two worlds.

◆ STORY ◆

Kiss her...

It is the only way to save two worlds from ruin.

Amejia was born from the fusion of Tokyo and another realm. As the chosen Prisma, Ryoma fights to prevent the extinction of both worlds.

Find the friends drawn into Amejia and awaken their hidden powers as Prisma Knights through the power of a kiss.

◆ WORLD ◆

Amejia is a transformed version of Tokyo that has merged with another world.

Featuring artwork inspired by Tokyo Fantasy, it offers a beautiful yet haunting world unlike any other.

Explore reimagined locations such as Shibuya and Akihabara.

◆ DUNGEON ◆

Mysterious labyrinths stretch across Amejia.

Battle monsters, solve puzzles, discover treasure, gather materials, and explore dangerous dungeons as you venture ever deeper.

◆ BATTLE ◆

The only way to save the world is a kiss!

Fight alongside the Prisma Knights in strategic turn-based battles.

Form a party of up to four characters, choose formations and skills, and adapt your tactics to every encounter.

An Auto-Battle feature is also available.

• Ex Skills

As a Prisma, Ryoma can absorb Ex, the energy that powers this world, by defeating enemies.

Share Ex with Prisma Knights through a kiss to awaken their strength and unleash powerful Ex Skills.

• Party Formation and Affinity

Up to four characters can participate in battle.

Team composition and relationships with allies both play important roles, so strengthen your bonds with a variety of companions.

• Enchant System

Combine skills attached to weapons, armor, and accessories to create customized battle strategies.

Gather materials, enhance your equipment, and prepare for powerful enemies.

*This product is based on Exstetra, originally released in 2013. Some features and specifications may differ from the original version.
